notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature and/or Food.
description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing any other creature or Food.
Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
